name: Farshad Khorrami
title: Professor; Director, Control/Robotics Research Laboratory
fitReason: CRRL combines substantial current embodied-AI policy research with a physical robotics lab. This is a stronger match through the world-model and visual-imitation projects than through the broader nonlinear-control/cybersecurity portfolio.

physicalEvidence.summary: DexWM, revised March 16, 2026, uses a learned human-video world model to optimize Franka Panda/Allegro actions. Its actual experiment has10 successful grasps among12 trials over four objects; optimized two-step actions execute open-loop. Reach/place benchmarks are simulation, and the small physical sample is not broad real-world validation. Lead author Raktim Goswami is a current CRRL PhD student. The current lab inventory includes three Franka arms, dexterous-hand equipment and legged platforms.

shortVisit.summary: The full current Join page accepts PhD applications and specifically welcomes current NYU master’s/undergraduate students. It also has postdoc inquiries. No external short-term master’s visitor invitation is stated; local thesis opportunities receive no visitor credit.

scoreReasons.physical: Direct primary physical study connected to current own student and lab equipment.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Current local-master’s wording does not invite external summer visitors.
scoreReasons.freshness: March 2026 revised physical source and June 2026 own-group methods paper.
